name: GJH Chibi Visitor
summary: Rigged R7 GJH Chibi Visitor with Wave, Idle, Blink, Cheer, and Jump animation clips.
description: A one-metre procedural robot character with a white hoodie, purple GJH lettering, violet happy eyes, and headphone rings. The default GLB is skinned with 14 joints and includes five animation clips.
author: Original owner-project procedural model
creation_method: Deterministic procedural geometry, materials, and rig generated headlessly with Blender from generate.py.
accuracy_notes: This is an original procedural interpretation, not an exact reconstruction or an independently approved match. The hood collar retains projecting tips, the ear fins remain thinner than the design sheet in side view, and the hand reaches the lower edge of the nearby ear cup at the Wave peak. Helmet and visor contours, headphone details, clothing folds, boots, shorts, and chest lettering remain simplified; PBR shading and uniform outlines differ from the illustrated linework. Wave begins and ends away from the unanimated rest pose, so runtimes should blend into and out of Wave. Cheer and Jump are sampled checks, not guarantees for continuous-time collisions, arbitrary views, accessory combinations, or cross-clip blends. The private design sheet is not redistributed.

attribution.credit: Original procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender 5.2.3 LTS for the owner's project; no third-party model is included.
Blender-bundled Bfont creates the GJH chest lettering as mesh geometry; no external font file is included.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
